title: Wilson–Davis meeting outside EG&G Las Vegas
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Wilson–Davis meeting outside EG&G Las Vegas, about 2002 (also given as 1997) at Las Vegas, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
place_text: EG&G special projects headquarters, Las Vegas

tellings.quote: A year after that, an infamous meeting would take place between scientist Eric Davis and Admiral Thomas Wilson, who oversaw basically all American military technology at the time.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of what he calls an infamous meeting between a scientist named Eric Davis and Admiral Thomas Wilson, a Navy officer who Michels says oversaw basically all American military technology at the time. He places it outside the Las Vegas special projects headquarters of EG&G, a defense contractor, and dates it to around 2002, though it is also given as 1997. Michels tells it as an important moment in the story of secret programs connected to UFOs.
